name: Braze
description: Braze is a customer engagement platform that helps brands deliver personalized experiences across email, SMS/RCS, WhatsApp, mobile push, and web messaging, unified through a real-time customer data platform and AI-driven orchestration.
best_for: Positioned for consumer brands in retail, financial services, travel, media, gaming, and quick-service restaurants that need cross-channel campaign orchestration at scale.
features: Cross-channel messaging across email, SMS/RCS, WhatsApp, mobile push, and web
BrazeAI Decisioning Studio for 1:1 personalization at scale
AI Agents for continuous, automated engagement
Braze Data Platform for unifying and activating customer data in real time
Journey Orchestration for multi-step, cross-channel campaigns

alternatives.name: Klaviyo
alternatives.description: An AI marketing and service platform built as an autonomous B2C CRM unifying customer data with omnichannel automation.
alternatives.best_for: E-commerce brands wanting unified customer data and marketing

alternatives.name: Adobe Marketo Engage
alternatives.description: An enterprise B2B marketing automation platform covering lead management, ABM, and campaign orchestration.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise B2B teams managing complex buying committees

alternatives.name: ActiveCampaign
alternatives.description: An autonomous marketing platform where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM tasks backed by customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses wanting automation with a built-in CRM

tiers.name: Braze Go
tiers.notes: Entry Platform Edition for early-stage growth teams; custom pricing.

tiers.name: Braze Select
tiers.notes: Adds orchestration capacity, security, and user provisioning; custom pricing.

tiers.name: Braze Pro
tiers.notes: Advanced BrazeAI and personalization; custom pricing.

cons: Braze does not publish a numeric rate card; pricing is customized around Platform Edition, active users, and flexible credits for messaging, features, and AI usage.
Costs can rise as the engaged audience, message volume, channels, or AI usage grows, so buyers need a usage-specific quote rather than a simple per-seat comparison.
